image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a group of young children participating in a maypole dance. The foreground features the backs and sides of several children holding colorful ribbons (streamers). A blonde child in a brown hoodie is central, holding red and blue streamers. To the left, a girl with dark hair holds a green streamer. The background shows other participants and trees, slightly out of focus. The top of the pole is not visible; only the hanging streamers and the dancers are in frame.
